ref_text: IT WAS IDLE FOR HIM TO MOVE HIMSELF TO BE GENEROUS TOWARDS THEM TO TELL HIMSELF THAT IF HE EVER CAME TO THEIR GATES STRIPPED OF HIS PRIDE BEATEN AND IN BEGGAR'S WEEDS THAT THEY WOULD BE GENEROUS TOWARDS HIM LOVING HIM AS THEMSELVES
text: It was idle for him to move himself to be generous towards them, to tell himself that if he ever came to their gates stripped of his pride, beaten and in beggars' weeds, that they would be generous towards him, loving him as themselves.
